Les épines de Dagmather entrent dans la préparation d'une décoction destinée aux atteintes du cartilage. Le traitement favorise la réparation de ces tissus, sans effet chiffré supplémentaire attesté dans notre source. This spine is found chiefly in semi-arid climates, especially in short-grass plains, and is best known throughout Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains hard to find.

Dagmather thorns are used to prepare a decoction for damaged cartilage. The treatment promotes repair of this tissue, with no additional numerical effect established in our source. Repeated doses can cause habituation; the Addiction Factor recorded on the item should therefore be retained.
